title: Death in the Salon
summary: A woman at a salon is found dead with all witnesses present in the room.
method: The victim was only sedated when she was discovered. The killer slipped benzos in her iced tea, then when the victim fell over, she used fake blood to make it appear like a stabbing and called everyone over. While the police were called, the killer stabbed the victim, then threw the weapon (scissors) on the roof, and ran the washing machine which had evidence of the fake blood she used.
motive: The killer was having an affair with her sister's fiance. The victim knew about it and was going to reveal the truth.
